column1: # Black/Matrix AD - Chapter 1 seasonal events: Domina
# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: $$セリ、なずな、ごぎょう、はこべら$$, henbit, turnip, daikon... the $$春の七草$$...
Spring flowers are lovely... so pretty and $$可愛い$$, they make me happy just looking at them.
Say... have you ever seen buckwheat flowers?
In summer, they bloom everywhere in a sea of white...
Ah... I would love to see that sight once more...
Kudzu, pampas grass, morning glory, dianthus, ominaeshi, bush clover, thoroughwort... the $$七草$$ of autumn...
Did you know? Pampas grass blooms in autumn... Spring is nice, but autumn flowers are lovely too!
Around this time of year, you sometimes see strawberry flowers...
Tiny, white flowers blooming by the roadside... so $$可愛い$$...!
Spring dawn... Good morning. How are you feeling?
What a pleasant morning breeze...
We need to work hard at $$リハビリ$$ again today!
Come on! Before the afternoon sun gets too strong, we have to get an early start today too!!
Good morning! It looks like it'll get hot again today!!
Even if you rake autumn away... it always comes back on its own...
Good morning. It will start getting cold soon... I should begin preparing for winter!
Good morning. The skies look like we might get snow today!
If winter comes, can spring be far behind...? Don't you feel as though you can hear spring's footsteps?
Good work! It's hot again today. Um, if you'd like... would you play in the water with me...?
Play in the water!
Don't play in the water!
To think I could do this with you again...
Ah! If you keep going, I can't...
Ah, honestly... that's my chest!
A $$台風$$! I have to do something about the leak, quickly!!
I'm sorry!
I made you overdo it, even though you're just recovering...
But I'm glad you're here...
If I were alone, I'd stay cold forever...
No, I'm not cold. I'm fine.
Just being with you makes me feel warm, deep in my heart...
I want to be with you... forever...
Pant... pant... S-Sorry!
I think I feel a little feverish...
Thank you for yesterday! I'm completely better, thanks to you!
You stayed with me all night, didn't you!?
I thought I was going to die yesterday!
Thank you... I think I'll be all right now...
But really... please don't go outside alone yet, okay!?
Heehee! Do you remember what day it is today~!?
Ta-daaaa~!!
Here! Happy $$誕生日$$!!
Hey...! I tried making something with a completely new $$レシピ$$—something no one has ever made before...?
Ta-daaaa~!!
Well? Would you try it for me...?
Pant... pant... I-I can't breathe...
S-Sorry! My stomach feels so full...
Pant... pant... I-I feel sick...
I'm sorry... I made you worry!
$$ドミナ$$ is gone!!
A-Are you okay!? You only woke up a week ago, and you're already up and about.
But don't push yourself. You don't seem fully recovered yet.
And... there's one important thing I need to ask.
This is important, so don't ever forget it.
You've lost your $$記憶$$ of this $$世界$$...
So you aren't used to this $$世界$$'s common sense, are you!?
So until I can feel safe letting you out of the house...
Please don't leave the fence around the house on your own.
Okay? Don't go outside!
It's a promise just between the two of us.
For a while, you need to properly work at your $$リハビリ$$!
Say...
Do you remember... what day today was?
